jsonld.abstract: Lagoon’s free course explorer at lagoonucsb.com/courses shows historical grade distributions for more than 10,000 UCSB courses, from Fall 2009 through Summer 2026: average GPA, the share of A-range and D/F grades, and breakdowns by instructor and quarter. The data is the Daily Nexus public dataset of UCSB Registrar records, obtained through public records requests, and no account is needed.
